en: Hi! You made it all the way here, past the whole Elite Four!
I'm Iris. I'm the Champion of the Pokémon League. Can you believe it? Sometimes I can't either.
I know how much your Pokémon trust you. I can tell just by looking at them. So let's have a battle we'll both remember!
You came back! I've been training every day, waiting for this. Let's go!
Wow... You're amazing! Your Pokémon fought their very hardest for you, and you fought for them.
That means you're the Champion now! Come with me. There's a room where every Champion is remembered.
Come on up! I'm waiting for you!
